== The Beginning of Alchemy ==
To unlock alchemy you must talk to [[Clotho]] who is found in the center of [[The Swamp]] during the Day.{{clear}}

==Processing==
[[file:Health Components.png|right|250px|All health components]]
Before making use of any items in alchemy, you've got to research them on the [[study table]]. This shows their decomposition products ("decomposes into"). It can be in the form of a powder, solution, or extract, even combinations are possible. 

Each form requires a different machine to process it:

* Powders are produced by the [[alchemy mill]].
* Solutions are produced by the [[hand mixer]].
* Extracts are produced by the [[distillation cube]].
When you've acquired the [[perk#Scientist Perk|scientist perk]], every machine yields one extra decomposition product per item processed. 

After unlocking [[zombie]]s, the usage of a [[zombie alchemy decomposer]] is possible to produce all three forms of substances.

==Elements==
Currently, there are eight known elements that are matched in pairs.  Health/Toxic, Order/Chaos, Acceleration/Slowness, and Life/Death. Substances are processed in many ways, but a substance can only have one element.

== Alchemy Workbench (Tier I) ==
The [[alchemy workbench (tier I)]] combines two ingredients, mostly powder and solution, in rare cases two liquids. To find useful alchemical combinations, one must experiment through trial and error.

A combination that does not produce a useful resource creates {{item|goo|1|animation}}. The type of goo hints what should be used instead of one of the ingredients. You've got to guess, if the first or the second one was wrong.

== Alchemy Workbench (Tier II) ==
The [[alchemy workbench (tier II)]] combines three ingredients: powder, solution, and extract, with the possibility to replace the solution or the extract by additional ingredients like alcohol or oil. There are significantly more possible combinations with an added ingredient, and thus more particular applications.

Failed reactions create {{item|goo|2|animation}}. The types of goo hint, that if you keep one of the three ingredients and replace the other two by the related ingredients, you'll get a working recipe. You still have to guess, which one to keep and how to replace the others, but it narrows down the possibilities quite considerably. Check the [[goo]] page for more details.

'''Note:''' It is '''not''' possible to craft the recipes from the tier I workbench here and leave the third slot empty.

'''Note:''' Required materials are entered from left to right in the order they appear.

== Alchemy for Embalming ==
If you want to embalm your corpses to maximize the number of {{Skull|white}}, you will need to use the following injections: {{Item|Glue injection}}, {{Item|Lye injection}}, {{Item|Silver elixir}}, {{Item|Golden elixir}}.  In order to mass-produce these four items, you will need to stockpile the following items, alternatively you can buy them all from [[Clotho]]:

{{Item|Conical flasks}}, from {{Item|Sand}} and {{Item|Water}}
